text: Zenith Aerospace, your ultimate RIVAL, announces a crewed launch plan. 'How hard can it possibly be?' asks its CEO.
Zenith reveals its rocket's name: The Condor. Fans are confused but excited.
Zenith hires 200 engineers and one very busy coffee machine.
Zenith's new logo costs $4M. It is a slightly different triangle.
Zenith says it is ahead of schedule. Its schedule could not be reached for comment.
Zenith engine test a success! The parking lot will also be repainted next week. Interesting.
Zenith's CEO calls your agency 'adorable.' Their rocket is 70 percent done.
Zenith paints its rocket gold. Engineeers ask if paint counts as progress.
Zenith names its launch date: Day 37. That is one day after your window opens.
Zenith sends your team a fruit basket, some chocolates and a mystery tool. The card reads: 'See you up there. Maybe.'
